title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: a bare save or delete counts the holders the bare read counts (ADR-0150 D3/D5)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBePzY6g11h3hyWk5ud4vWy)_

Fixes #34144
Fixes #33955
Fixes #34262

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — a `git grep` of `skills/` finds no text that teaches a bare save or delete of a name two enabled packages hold or only disabled packages hold

> **BREAKING (declared narrowing).** Every moved answer goes from accepted to refused, and nothing that was refused is now accepted. The changeset carries the ADR-0087 marker (`not-required (no-migration-prescription)`).

> **Waits on #33995.** That PR pins the opposite answer for the #34262 cell: `packages/objectql/src/disabled-holder-packageless-row-doors.test.ts`, the review#2 S3 case, expects the bare save at the never-shipped member to succeed while the package is disabled. #33995 lands first. After it merges, this branch merges `origin/main` and flips that save pin to this refusal, keeping its delete half unchanged. Until then this PR stays a draft and is not mergeable.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：不带包名保存或删除一个名字时，现在按读取的规则数持有者。两个以上启用中的包持有时，拒绝（409）并列出这些包。只有停用的包持有时，拒绝并提示用 `?package=`，不点名任何包。
- 为什么改：读取已经这样回答（409 列出两个包，或 404），保存却返回 200，悄悄改写某个包的行，或写出一条读不到的行。这违反 ADR-0150 红线 2（有歧义就报告，不猜），也违反裁决 A。
- 风险与回滚：这是声明过的收窄，原来能保存的现在被拒绝。只影响两种状态，带 `?package=` 的写入和环境自己的条目不变。回滚就是撤销这个 PR，不涉及存储行。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save.ts` 文件末尾的 `packagelessHolderRefusal` 和两处调用；`protocol-diff-delete-load.ts` 里删除的那一处调用；然后是测试文件末尾新增的用例。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build && cd packages/runtime && pnpm exec vitest run --project local src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`，预期 1 个文件、全部用例通过。
- 需要你做的：等 #33995 合并后，由席位在本 PR 合并 main 并翻转它的保存断言，再落地。你这边无需操作。

## What changes

A write that names no package (`PUT` / `DELETE /meta/:type/:name` with no `?package=`, `saveMetaItem` / `deleteMetaItem` with no `packageId`) took its address from the stored rows' bindings alone (`packagelessAddress`), while the bare read counts the name's holders. One new judgment, `packagelessHolderRefusal` in `protocol-save.ts`, runs after the existing judgments (`servedPackagelessSaveAddress` and the two-bindings refusal), so neither of their answers moves. It is asked by the publish-mode bare save, the draft-mode bare save, and the bare delete (`protocol-diff-delete-load.ts`, the delete half only).

- **Two or more enabled holders (#33955, ADR-0150 D3/D5, red line 2).** The judgment asks the package-scoped resolver, `registry.resolveItem(type, name, null, member)`, which the by-name read asks before any layer. When it refuses `ambiguous-in-environment`, the write is refused with the existing `packagelessAddressAmbiguityRefusal`, which names those packages.
- **Only disabled holders (#34144 ruling A, #34262).** When every holder of the name is disabled, the write is refused with `disabledHoldersOnlyRefusal`. Holders here are registry holders, code shippers and stored-row bindings, and a row bound to a disabled holder's customization pair counts as that holder. The refusal is `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (the same family, no new code) with the `?package=` remedy, and it names no package.
- **Left alone.** A package-unbound row stored at the address, the environment's own item, a type the registry does not read by package, and a registry without the reads.

Commits: one per card. #34144 is the disabled-only arm, its pins and the flipped #33889 CONTROL. #33955 is the resolver arm and its pins. #34262 is a pin only: the #34144 arm already covers that cell.

| Door (no package named) | State | FROM | TO |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| publish save | only disabled D holds, D's row alone | 200, D's row updated | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `?package=` remedy, no package named; D's row byte-unchanged |
| publish save | only disabled D ships it, no stored row | 200, package-unbound row written (every read withholds it) | 409 as above, nothing written |
| publish save | only disabled D ships it, D's row | 200, D's row updated | 409 as above, row unchanged |
| draft save | only disabled D ships it, no stored row | 200, package-unbound draft written | 409 as above, nothing written |
| delete | only disabled D ships it, D's row | 200, D's row removed | 409 as above, row stays |
| publish save, `email_template` | every holder disabled, a member D never ships (#34262) and the member it ships | 200, package-unbound row stored and withheld | 409 as above, nothing stored |
| publish save | two enabled packages ship it, no stored row | 200, package-unbound row written | 409 naming both, nothing written |
| publish save | two enabled ship it, one package's row (either) | 200, that row updated | 409 naming both, row unchanged |
| draft save | two enabled ship it, no stored row | 200, package-unbound draft written | 409 naming both |
| delete | two enabled ship it, E's row | 200, E's row removed | 409 naming both, row stays |

Unchanged, pinned as CONTROLs: a row of each of two enabled holders (409 before and after); `?package=D` and `?package=E` saves and deletes; a name one enabled package holds; every #32605 cell (an enabled beside a disabled holder); a name no package holds; a package-unbound row at the address (the save edits it and the delete removes it); and every bare write once the package is enabled again.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`, inside the existing #32605 bare-save harness (shared-harness rule). Every new pin runs on a booted kernel, through both transports (the runtime dispatcher and `RestServer`) and in both registration orders. The harness's `put` now takes a query (`?package=`, `?mode=draft`).
  - The #33889 CONTROL "a name only the disabled D holds … is saved as before" is flipped to ruling A's refusal, with `?package=D` and re-enable as CONTROLs.
  - #34144: the bare save over no row and over D's row, the draft save, and the bare delete with the delete naming D as CONTROL. Also the environment's own items.
  - #33955: rows 0 / E's / D's / both, the bare read's 409 beside the save's, the draft save and delete, `?package=E` as CONTROL, and the package-unbound row as CONTROL.
  - #34262: the `email_template` member D never ships and the one it ships, with re-enable as CONTROL.
- Refusals assert `code` and `status`, the `?package=` remedy, and which packages are named or not named. The rest of the wording is not pinned.

<details><summary>Ablations (one per arm, each rebuilt into dist and checked there)</summary>

- Disabled-only arm: the anchor `return disabledHoldersOnlyRefusal(...)` was replaced with a guarded copy carrying the marker `ABLATION_34144_NEVER`. `ablation-replace` reported anchor 1 to 0, blob 38624bc72dbf to 006312afca07. `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker present in 2 built files. Result: Tests 20 failed, 108 passed. The 20 are exactly the five ruling-A pins in all four transport and order cases, including the #34262 pin. Every CONTROL stayed green.
- Enabled-holders arm: the `held.length > 1` refusal was guarded with the marker `ABLATION_33955_NEVER`, giving blob 38624bc72dbf to fbc5c93f2c63, with the marker present in 2 built files. Result: Tests 16 failed, 112 passed. The 16 are the three new #33955 rows plus the draft and delete pin, in all four cases. The "row of each" CONTROL stayed green, refused by the stored rows' own refusal as before.

## Acceptance notes

- Boundary, kept as the order's CONTROL: a package-unbound row of a name only a disabled package ships (`d_unbound_dash`). The bare read answers 404, but the bare save still edits that row. The `?package=` remedy cannot reach a package-unbound row, so refusing would leave no way to write it while the package is disabled. This is reported in the report, not changed here.
- Measured: two enabled shippers plus a package-unbound row laid straight into the store. The bare read answers 409, because the registry has not hydrated the row, while the save edits the row, as before. The save keeps the prefer-local rule (ADR-0048).
- The `email_template` save at the member the package ships answered 200 in this harness (a code-registered package), not 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` as in #33995's harness. Both now refuse while every holder is disabled.
